title: Vitess: backup restore round-trip (reload + count + drop)
description: Runs `nexus backup restore vitess <id>`: reloads each shard dump into a throwaway commerce_restore_verify DB (sql_log_bin=0 so it never replicates), counts rows, drops it. Proves the logical backup is loadable.

observe.what: items restored = 101 (54 from -80 + 47 from 80-); each verify DB created, counted, and dropped

whatProves: VitessAdapter.BackupRestoreAsync reloads each shard dump into a scratch DB on the shard primary, sums the row counts (the round-trip proof), and drops the scratch DB.
